sourceEvidence.title: Industry Solution Leader - High Tech Manufacturing (Semiconductor and Fuel Cell Fabrication)
sourceEvidence.quote: C3 AI (NYSE: AI), is the Enterprise AI application software company. C3 AI delivers a family of fully integrated products including the C3 Agentic AI Platform, an end-to-end platform for developing, deploying, and operating enterprise AI applications, C3 AI applications, a portfolio of industry-specific SaaS enterprise AI applications that enable the digital transformation of organizations globally, and C3 Generative AI, a suite of domain-specific generative AI offerings for the enterprise. Learn more at: C3 AI C3 AI is seeking an Industry Solution Leader (ISL) for High Tech Manufacturing to lead the design and delivery of enterprise AI solutions for its clients with a specialization in Semiconductor and Fuel Cell Fabrication. C3 AI is seeking an Industry Solution Director, Supply Chain to lead the design and delivery of enterprise AI solutions for complex global supply chain and manufacturing organizations. Industry Solution Directors combine deep domain expertise with end-to-end ownership of customer solutions. They are expected to understand a customer's supply chain and operating environment deeply enough to challenge assumptions, identify and quantify the highest-value opportunities, define the right technical solution, and lead cross-functional teams through design, deployment, validation, and scale. The role combines the responsibilities of a senior supply chain expert and solution leader. Industry Solution Directors work directly with customer supply chain, manufacturing, procurement, logistics, finance, technology, and executive teams while leading C3 AI Forward Deployed Engineers, data scientists, product teams, and other technical resources to deliver measurable business outcomes. The ideal candidate brings significant experience in supply chain planning, manufacturing operations, inventory management, production planning, logistics, procurement, pricing, or operations research and has the technical judgment, customer leadership, and delivery ownership required to lead complex enterprise AI solutions from problem definition through production.
